title: Source shard
description: One regional slice of the source catalog. Every file under catalog/sources/ matches this.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. The app refuses a catalog it does not understand rather than guessing at the shape.

shard.description: Matches the shard id in catalog/index.json.

id.description: Stable, permanent identifier. A user's saved selection refers to this, so renaming one silently deselects that source for everyone.

name.description: Shown in the source picker. Include the section when the publisher has several feeds.

url.description: The feed endpoint. https only — the app refuses any other scheme.

kind.description: How the source is read. 'feed' covers RSS, Atom and JSON Feed, sniffed from the payload.

scope.description: How wide the outlet's remit is. Drives where it sits in the picker and how the ranking treats it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Required for everything except a global source, and must exist in taxonomy.json.

region.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, e.g. 'US-CA'. Must exist under its country in taxonomy.json.

city.description: Taxonomy city id, e.g. 'helsinki'. Must exist under its country in taxonomy.json.

languages.description: BCP-47 tags of the output, most representative first. The app uses the first as the source's language.

topics.description: The app's ten editorial topics. Used when a feed's own categories are unusable.

weight.description: Editorial weight multiplied into the ranking score. Not an endorsement — it is how loudly this outlet argues for its own stories.

pollIntervalSecs.description: How often to poll. The app clamps this to at least 60 anyway; a catalog should not ask for something impolite.

publisher.description: Publisher name as it should appear on screen. Attribution is displayed for every story.

publisherLink.description: Publisher home page, shown as the link back.

rights.description: Rights notice, when the publisher states one.

verifiedAt.description: Date the URL was last confirmed live. Set it when you add or fix an entry.

allOf.description: A global source has no home country; everything else must name one.
A subdivision or city only means something under a country.

logo.description: A logo committed under assets/. The app renders text attribution only — this exists so the schema need not change when a logo tier is built.

license.description: How the mark may be used. Almost always 'trademark': included as nominative use, not licensed to us.
